context:
Goal: stop notes.md inserts and edits from making drafts dirty on GitHub.
Problem (rule): your pick on item 903 a (one file per note) read literally moves all 2304 old notes, which deletes docs/debts/notes.md and gives every open branch that edits it a modify/delete conflict (the plan's proxy: up to 1537 unmerged branches touch it; the order's figure is about 132 drafts; unmeasured). It also needs 280 renames of slugs over 32 characters, 55 duplicate merges and 8 slug-less lines named by hand. The lane's plan (Plan agent opus; a refuter opus said "revise", its revisions taken in) keeps the old file and puts only NEW notes in docs/notes/<slug>.md, which departs from a literal 903 a.
Based on (measured): docs/debts/notes.md is 2313 lines, 2304 notes; main's notes.md churn since Nov 8: 71 of 140 first-parent merges touched it (+2358/-1554) (lane's read, not checked by triage).
Based on (ruling): item 903 a.
Departs from: main and from 903 a read literally — old notes stay in one file, new notes go one file each.
The refuter's cheaper alternative, not recommended: one file sorted by slug with a sorted-check. It still clashes on neighbouring inserts and drops your pick.
The lane takes the refuter's other revisions without asking: per-slug copy counts at merge base and head, refuse an added line with no key, docs/notes/README.md defines the format, a 32-character cap check, and a fix at docs/decisions/guard-remedy-not-to-owner.md:133.
Step notes-sightings-expiry (PR #1619, doing) builds on the one-line note format; its order against this lane is the coordinator's.

options.gain: No modify/delete conflict; lands in one lane (about 6 agents); a draft that only adds a note adds one small file.

title: May the notes lane keep the 2304 old notes in one file and give only new notes their own files?
why: It removes the conflict at once, and migrating the old notes later is its own step.
